title: Billing ETL warehouse timeout runbook
content: Billing ETL can fail when warehouse active sessions reach the configured maximum. Check Vertica active sessions, connection pool usage, and long-running load jobs before retrying.

title: Previous RCA for billing ETL failure
content: A prior billing ETL incident was caused by warehouse connection pool exhaustion. PostgreSQL logs showed connection timeout and Vertica metrics showed max sessions reached.

title: ETL retry SOP
content: Do not restart failed ETL jobs until warehouse sessions normalize. Capture logs, metrics, and job status before retrying.
